site.title: FlowSnap — macOS Window Manager with Intent & Snap Precision
site.description: Native macOS window manager with Windows 11-style snap picker, multi-display intent restoration, Quake scratchpad, and zero private APIs.

hero.subtitle: Native window management engineered with intent-based workspace restoration, Windows 11-style top-edge layout picker, and zero private APIs.

showcase.desc: Drag windows, test top-edge snap layouts, and trigger translucent HUD previews directly in your browser.
showcase.mobileFallback: Best experienced on desktop — try the interactive sandbox on a larger screen

features.title: Engineered for Focus & Intent
features.desc: 6 breakthrough capabilities bringing Windows 11 elegance to native macOS speed.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts Matrix
shortcuts.desc: Full spectrum keyboard navigation for windows, multi-display throws, and presets.

download.title: Get Started with FlowSnap
download.desc: One-click terminal install, verified DMG packages, and offline privacy manifesto.

features.title: Top-Edge Snap Layout Picker
features.description: Drag any window to the top edge to reveal an intuitive layout picker: 50/50, 70/30, 3-column, and 4-corner grids. Drop into any zone for instant snapping.

features.title: Adaptive Collinear 2D Resize
features.description: Drag shared divider borders or crosshair intersections to simultaneously resize 2 to 4 adjacent windows at 60 FPS without breaking layout symmetry.

features.title: Current Space Preservation
features.description: Newly launched apps appear strictly in your current active workspace. Permanently ends macOS from jarringly jumping to another virtual desktop space.

features.title: Intent-Based Workspaces & Presets
features.description: Save and restore full application workspace groups (Coding, Research, Writing) mapped by screen-independent percentages with a single keystroke.

features.title: Quake-Style Quick Scratchpad
features.description: Summon a dedicated utility window (Terminal, Notes, Finder) floating in front in < 50ms. Dismiss quickly with ESC without shrinking underlying windows by 1 pixel.

features.title: Display-Aware Multi-Monitor Topology
features.description: Throw windows across screens with dedicated hotkeys (⌃⌥⇧→), automatically scaling proportions between Retina displays and 4K monitors with pixel-perfect math.

privacy.title: Privacy & Transparency Manifesto
privacy.desc: FlowSnap is built for engineers and power users who value security. Zero compromises on personal data.

pillars.title: 100% Offline Operation
pillars.description: FlowSnap runs completely locally on your Mac without making any external outbound network requests.
details: No account registration or login required
Zero configuration or layout data sent outside

pillars.title: Zero Telemetry & Tracking
pillars.description: Strictly zero telemetry, analytics, user profiling, or behavioral tracking SDKs integrated.
details: No Google Analytics, Sentry, or Mixpanel SDKs
No cookies, fingerprinting, or device identifiers
100% open source for independent public audits

pillars.title: Transparent Accessibility Permissions
pillars.description: Accessibility (AX) APIs are strictly utilized to compute and navigate window frame coordinates.
details: Operates strictly on window size and position frames
Zero Keylogging guarantee: Never listens to keystroke contents
Zero memory inspection or interference with other applications

gatekeeper.title: Seeing "Unidentified Developer" warning from macOS Gatekeeper?
gatekeeper.summary: Because FlowSnap is community-driven open source (without a commercial paid Apple Developer certificate), macOS applies quarantine flags on first launch.
gatekeeper.hint: Quick 5-second quarantine removal for macOS Sequoia & Sonoma
